triage.summary: Anna Belyaeva from TeaWorld support reports that two customers today received another customer's order status from the bot. The order numbers differ by one digit, raising a potential customer-data exposure issue.

task.title: Investigate the bot exposing other customers' order statuses
task.description: Anna Belyaeva (anna@teaworld.ru), TeaWorld support, requests investigation as soon as possible. On October 12, two customers reported seeing another customer's order status; the order numbers differ by one digit. Obtain the affected order numbers and interaction times, investigate order matching and access checks, and determine how to prevent further exposure.

reply.body:
Анна, здравствуйте.

Спасибо, что сообщили. Посмотрю, почему бот показывает статус чужого заказа. Пришлите, пожалуйста, номера затронутых заказов и примерное время обращений, чтобы я мог найти их в логах.

Алекс
